GENTEXT/REMARKS/MARS to activate multi-layer HF radio networks to 
support COMEX 19-4. 
 
This exercise is a simulation.  No actual disruption to national 
infrastructure is associated with this exercise.  This message 
begins exercise Phase 2. 
 
MARS stations begin exercising the time period immediately 
following a notional (simulated) denial of service to 
telecommunications and power infrastructure.  If this were an 
actual incident, in addition to instructions this message would 
contain what known, releasable information exists about the 
situation.  The current situation is that no incident has actually 
occurred and telecommunications and power are operating normally. 
 
MARS members shall exercise a bias for action, perform tasks, 
coordinate with Amateur Radio stations, and provide true and 
accurate information products as they actually exist. 
 
All MARS stations activate region and national multi-layer HF 
networks and submit COMSPOT reports indicating the planned 
operations over the next 48 hours.// 
GENTEXT/AUTHENTICATION/XXX//
